description.description: Why/how/outcome description; a default is generated when omitted.

labels.description: Persisted loop labels; normalized lowercase and deduplicated.

at.description: Absolute date/time parseable by JavaScript Date (ISO 8601 recommended).

anchor.description: fixed_rate anchors slots to the original cadence; fixed_delay measures from the previous finish.

expression.description: 5-field cron expression evaluated in local time.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum spacing between runs in milliseconds.

timeoutMs.description: Per-run timeout in milliseconds; null disables the timeout.

catchUp.description: Missed-slot policy after downtime: none skips them, latest replays the newest slot, all replays every slot.

catchUpLimit.description: Maximum missed slots replayed when catching up.

overlap.description: Behavior when a slot comes due while a previous run is active: skip records a skipped run, allow runs concurrently.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts per slot before a failed run is final (default 1).

retryDelayMs.description: Base retry delay in milliseconds (exponential backoff with jitter).

leaseMs.description: Run lease in milliseconds before an unresponsive runner is considered dead.

expiresAt.description: Date/time after which the loop expires and stops scheduling.

command.description: Executable to run (resolved via PATH); not a shell string.

args.description: Argv-style arguments passed to the command.

shell.description: Not supported over MCP: shell execution is rejected. Use 'command' plus 'args' instead.
